concepts.label: Entity Common Stock, Shares Outstanding
concepts.description: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each class/interest by adding class of stock items such as Common Class A [Member], Common Class B [Member] or Partnership Interest [Member] onto the Instrument [Domain] of the Entity Listings, Instrument.

concepts.label: Entity Public Float
concepts.description: The aggregate market value of the voting and non-voting common equity held by non-affiliates computed by reference to the price at which the common equity was last sold, or the average bid and asked price of such common equity, as of the last business day of the registrant's most recently completed second fiscal quarter.

concepts.label: Accounts and Other Receivables, Net, Current
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance, receivable from customers, clients, or other third-parties, and receivables classified as other due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due within one year (or the operating cycle, if longer), including liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received, taxes, interest, rent and utilities, accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

concepts.label: Accounts Payable and Other Accrued Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Amount of liabilities incurred to vendors for goods and services received, and accrued liabilities classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Accounts Payable, Other, Current
concepts.description: Amount of obligations incurred classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Accounts Payable, Related Parties, Current
concepts.description: Amount for accounts payable to related parties. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Accounts Payable, Trade, Current
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Accounts Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as current.

concepts.label: Accrual for Taxes Other than Income Taxes, Current
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for real and property taxes. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Accrued Advertising, Current
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for advertising of the entity's goods and services. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Accrued Income Taxes, Current
concepts.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the unpaid sum of the known and estimated amounts payable to satisfy all currently due domestic and foreign income tax obligations.

concepts.label: Accrued Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable, pertaining to costs that are statutory in nature, are incurred on contractual obligations, or accumulate over time and for which invoices have not yet been received or will not be rendered. Examples include taxes, interest, rent and utilities. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Accrued Sales Commission, Current
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for sales commissions. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment
concepts.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization for physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

concepts.label: AOCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Adjustment, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

concepts.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cumulative Changes in Net Gain (Loss) from Cash Flow Hedges, Effect Net of Tax
concepts.description: Accumulated change, net of tax, in accumulated gains and losses from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges. Includes an entity's share of an equity investee's Increase or Decrease in deferred hedging gains or losses.

concepts.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
concepts.description: Accumulated change in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, net of tax effect, at period end. Excludes Net Income (Loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners. Includes foreign currency translation items, certain pension adjustments, unrealized gains and losses on certain investments in debt and equity securities, other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses related to factors other than credit losses on available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities that an entity does not intend to sell and it is not more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell before recovery of the amortized cost basis, as well as changes in the fair value of derivatives related to the effective portion of a designated cash flow hedge.

concepts.label: Additional Paid in Capital
concepts.description: Excess of issue price over par or stated value of the entity's capital stock and amounts received from other transactions involving the entity's stock or stockholders. Includes adjustments to additional paid in capital. Some examples of such adjustments include recording the issuance of debt with a beneficial conversion feature and certain tax consequences of equity instruments awarded to employees. Use this element for the aggregate amount of additional paid-in capital associated with common and preferred stock. For additional paid-in capital associated with only common stock, use the element additional paid in capital, common stock. For additional paid-in capital associated with only preferred stock, use the element additional paid in capital, preferred stock.

concepts.label: Additional Paid in Capital, Common Stock
concepts.description: Value received from shareholders in common stock-related transactions that are in excess of par value or stated value and amounts received from other stock-related transactions. Includes only common stock transactions (excludes preferred stock transactions). May be called contributed capital, capital in excess of par, capital surplus, or paid-in capital.

concepts.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Decrease for Tax Withholding Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of decrease to equity for grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Increase for Cost Recognition
concepts.description: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation
concepts.description: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a tax benefit associated with share-based compensation plan other than an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP). Includes, but is not limited to, excess tax benefit.

concepts.label: Adjustment to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Effect from Share-based Compensation, Net
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a tax benefit (deficiency) associated with an share-based compensation plan other than an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

concepts.label: Advertising Expense
concepts.description: Amount charged to advertising expense for the period, which are expenses incurred with the objective of increasing revenue for a specified brand, product or product line.

concepts.label: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts Receivable, Charge-offs (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of direct write-downs of receivables charged against the allowance for doubtful accounts.

concepts.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
concepts.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, classified as current.

concepts.label: Amortization of Debt Discount (Premium)
concepts.description: Amount of noncash expense included in interest expense to amortize debt discount and premium associated with the related debt instruments. Excludes amortization of financing costs. Alternate captions include noncash interest expense.

concepts.label: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs and Discounts
concepts.description: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

concepts.label: Amortization of Intangible Assets
concepts.description: The aggregate expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of intangible assets (nonphysical assets not used in production) in a systematic and rational manner to the periods expected to benefit from such assets. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

concepts.label: Amount of Restricted Net Assets for Consolidated and Unconsolidated Subsidiaries
concepts.description: Amount of restricted net assets of consolidated and unconsolidated subsidiaries as of the end of the most recently completed fiscal year.

concepts.label: Antidilutive Securities Excluded from Computation of Earnings Per Share, Amount
concepts.description: Securities (including those issuable pursuant to contingent stock agreements) that could potentially dilute basic earnings per share (EPS) or earnings per unit (EPU) in the future that were not included in the computation of diluted EPS or EPU because to do so would increase EPS or EPU amounts or decrease loss per share or unit amounts for the period presented.

concepts.label: Asset Impairment Charges
concepts.description: Amount of write-down of assets recognized in the income statement. Includes, but is not limited to, losses from tangible assets, intangible assets and goodwill.

concepts.label: Asset Retirement Obligation
concepts.description: The carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

concepts.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Accretion Expense
concepts.description: Amount of accretion expense recognized during the period that is associated with an asset retirement obligation. Accretion expense measures and incorporates changes due to the passage of time into the carrying amount of the liability.

concepts.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Liabilities Incurred
concepts.description: Amount of asset retirement obligations incurred during the period.

concepts.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Liabilities Settled
concepts.description: Amount of asset retirement obligations settled, or otherwise disposed of, during the period. This may include asset retirement obligations transferred to third parties associated with the sale of a long-lived asset.

concepts.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Revision of Estimate
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the asset retirement obligation from changes in the amount or timing of the estimated cash flows associated with the settlement of the obligation.

concepts.label: Assets
concepts.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

concepts.label: Assets, Current
concepts.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold, or consumed within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

concepts.label: Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
concepts.description: Fair value portion of probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

concepts.label: Assets Held-for-sale, Current (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
concepts.description: Current assets (normally turning over within one year or one business cycle if longer) that are held for sale apart from normal operations and anticipated to be sold within one year.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Assets, Current
concepts.description: Amount classified as assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Available-for-sale Securities
concepts.description: Amount of investment in debt and equity securities categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading.

concepts.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Amortized Cost Basis
concepts.description: This item represents the cost of debt and equity securities, which are categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading, net of adjustments including accretion, amortization, collection of cash, previous other-than-temporary impairments recognized in earnings (less any cumulative-effect adjustments recognized, as defined), and fair value hedge accounting adjustments, if any.

concepts.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Current
concepts.description: Amount of investment in debt and equity securities categorized neither as trading securities nor held-to-maturity securities and intended be sold or mature one year or operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Fair Value Disclosure (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: This element represents the portion of the balance sheet assertion valued at fair value by the entity whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements. The element may be used in both the balance sheet and disclosure in the same submission. This item represents Available-for-sale Securities which consist of all investments in certain debt and equity securities neither classified as trading or held-to-maturity securities. A debt security represents a creditor relationship with an enterprise. Debt securities include, among other items, US Treasury securities, US government securities, municipal securities, corporate bonds, convertible debt, commercial paper, and all securitized debt instruments. An equity security represents an ownership interest in an enterprise or the right to acquire or dispose of an ownership interest in an enterprise at fixed or determinable prices. Equity securities include, among other things, common stock, certain preferred stock, warrant rights, call options, and put options, but do not include convertible debt. An entity may opt to provide the reader with additional narrative text to better understand the nature of investments in debt and equity securities which are categorized as Available-for-sale.

concepts.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Unrealized Losses (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: This item represents the gross unrealized losses for securities, at a point in time, which are categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading securities.

concepts.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Unrealized Gains (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: This item represents the gross unrealized gains for securities, at a point in time, which are categorized neither as held-to-maturity nor trading securities.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Percentage of Voting Interests Acquired
concepts.description: Percentage of voting equity interests acquired at the acquisition date in the business combination.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Earnings Per Share, Basic
concepts.description: The pro forma basic net income per share for a period as if the business combination or combinations had been completed at the beginning of a period.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Earnings Per Share, Diluted
concepts.description: The pro forma diluted net income per share for a period as if the business combination or combinations had been completed at the beginning of a period.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Goodwill, Expected Tax Deductible Amount
concepts.description: The amount of goodwill arising from a business combination that is expected to be deductible for tax purposes.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Net Income (Loss)
concepts.description: The pro forma net Income or Loss for the period as if the business combination or combinations had been completed at the beginning of a period.

concepts.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Revenue
concepts.description: The pro forma revenue for a period as if the business combination or combinations had been completed at the beginning of the period.

concepts.label: Business Combination, Acquisition Related Costs
concepts.description: This element represents acquisition-related costs incurred to effect a business combination which costs have been expensed during the period. Such costs include finder's fees; advisory, legal, accounting, valuation, and other professional or consulting fees; general administrative costs, including the costs of maintaining an internal acquisitions department; and may include costs of registering and issuing debt and equity securities.

concepts.label: Business Combination, Integration Related Costs
concepts.description: Costs incurred to effect a business combination which have been expensed during the period. Such costs could include business integration costs, systems integration and conversion costs, and severance and other employee-related costs.

concepts.label: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
concepts.description: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.

concepts.label: Capitalized Computer Software, Impairments
concepts.description: Amount of impairment loss from capitalized computer software costs.

concepts.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Amortization
concepts.description: Amount of amortization expense for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

concepts.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Impairment Loss
concepts.description: Amount of impairment loss for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

concepts.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Net
concepts.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

concepts.label: Capitalized Costs, Asset Retirement Costs
concepts.description: The amount of asset retirement costs previously incurred and capitalized separately from the capitalized amount of the associated long-lived assets.

concepts.label: Capital Leased Assets, Gross
concepts.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of leased physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

concepts.label: Capital Lease Obligations
concepts.description: Amount equal to the present value (the principal) at the beginning of the lease term of minimum lease payments during the lease term (excluding that portion of the payments representing executory costs such as insurance, maintenance, and taxes to be paid by the lessor, together with any profit thereon) net of payments or other amounts applied to the principal through the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Lease Obligations, Current
concepts.description: Amount of capital lease obligation due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Lease Obligation Incurred
concepts.description: Amount of increase in lease obligation from new lease.

concepts.label: Capital Lease Obligations, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount equal to the present value (the principal) at the beginning of the lease term of minimum lease payments during the lease term (excluding that portion of the payments representing executory costs such as insurance, maintenance, and taxes to be paid by the lessor, together with any profit thereon) net of payments or other amounts applied to the principal, through the balance sheet date and due to be paid more than one year (or one operating cycle, if longer) after the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due, Next Twelve Months
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Five Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Four Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling after Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Four
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Three
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Two
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Three Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Two Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due Thereafter
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Executory Costs
concepts.description: Amounts to be paid by lessee to lessor for maintenance, insurance, and tax expenses related to the leased asset.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Interest Included in Payments
concepts.description: Amount necessary to reduce net minimum lease payments to present value for capital leases.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Next Rolling Twelve Months
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Present Value of Net Minimum Payments
concepts.description: Present value of minimum lease payments for capital leases net of executory costs, including amounts paid by the lessee to the lessor for insurance, maintenance and taxes.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Remainder of Fiscal Year
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Capital Leases, Lessee Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Accumulated Depreciation
concepts.description: The total charge for the use of long-lived depreciable assets subject to a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization.

concepts.label: Cash Acquired from Acquisition
concepts.description: The cash inflow associated with the acquisition of business during the period (for example, cash that was held by the acquired business).

concepts.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
concepts.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

concepts.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, Fair Value Disclosure
concepts.description: Fair value portion of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

concepts.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease)
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalents. Cash and cash equivalents are the amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Includes effect from exchange rate changes.

concepts.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents
concepts.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage. Excludes amount for disposal group and discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

concepts.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Including Exchange Rate Effect
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash, cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; including effect from exchange rate change. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

concepts.label: Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) to be Reclassified within Twelve Months
concepts.description: The estimated net amount of existing gains or losses on cash flow hedges at the reporting date expected to be reclassified to earnings within the next 12 months.

concepts.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities, Discontinued Operations
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of operating activities of discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
concepts.description: Face amount or stated value per share of common stock.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Shares Authorized
concepts.description: The maximum number of common shares permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Shares, Issued
concepts.description: Total number of common shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders (includes common shares that were issued, repurchased and remain in the treasury). These shares represent capital invested by the firm's shareholders and owners, and may be all or only a portion of the number of shares authorized. Shares issued include shares outstanding and shares held in the treasury.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
concepts.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

concepts.label: Common Stock, Value, Issued
concepts.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

concepts.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
concepts.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

concepts.label: Consideration Received for Beneficial Interest Obtained for Transferring Financial Asset
concepts.description: Amount of beneficial interest received as consideration for transferring noncash financial asset. Includes, but is not limited to, trade receivable in securitization transaction.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability
concepts.description: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Current
concepts.description: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Revenue Recognized
concepts.description: Amount of revenue recognized that was previously included in balance of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due.

concepts.label: Contract with Customer, Performance Obligation Satisfied in Previous Period
concepts.description: Amount of revenue recognized from performance obligation satisfied or partially satisfied in previous reporting periods. Includes, but is not limited to, change in transaction price.

concepts.label: Contribution of Property
concepts.description: Value of property contributed in noncash investing and financing activities.

concepts.label: Convertible Preferred Dividends, Net of Tax
concepts.description: The after-tax amount of any dividends on convertible preferred stock.

concepts.label: Convertible Preferred Stock, Shares Issued upon Conversion
concepts.description: Number of shares issued for each share of convertible preferred stock that is converted.

concepts.label: Cost of Goods and Services Sold
concepts.description: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

concepts.label: Cost of Goods Sold (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
concepts.description: Total costs related to goods produced and sold during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Cost of Services (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
concepts.description: Total costs related to services rendered by an entity during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Cost of Services, Excluding Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
concepts.description: The aggregate cost of services rendered during the reporting period, excluding depreciation, depletion and amortization.

concepts.label: Costs and Expenses
concepts.description: Total costs of sales and operating expenses for the period.

concepts.label: Cumulative Effect on Retained Earnings, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount of the cumulative effect on retained earnings net of related income tax effect.

concepts.label: Current Federal Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of current federal tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Current Foreign Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of current foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Current Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to taxable income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Current State and Local Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of current state and local tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Debt and Lease Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of short-term and long-term debt and lease obligation.

concepts.label: Debt, Current
concepts.description: Amount of short-term debt and current maturity of long-term debt and capital lease obligations due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Long-term Debt, Gross
concepts.description: Amount, before unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but is not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, commercial loans, mortgage loans, convertible debt, subordinated debt and other types of debt.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Face Amount
concepts.description: Face (par) amount of debt instrument at time of issuance.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Increase (Decrease), Other, Net
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in debt instruments, classified as other.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate During Period
concepts.description: The average effective interest rate during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Effective Percentage
concepts.description: Effective interest rate for the funds borrowed under the debt agreement considering interest compounding and original issue discount or premium.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Repurchased Face Amount
concepts.description: Face (par) amount of the original debt instrument that was repurchased.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount
concepts.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt discount.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium) and Debt Issuance Costs, Net
concepts.description: Amount of unamortized debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

concepts.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Premium
concepts.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt premium.

concepts.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Line of Credit Arrangements, Net
concepts.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs related to line of credit arrangements. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

concepts.label: Debt, Long-term and Short-term, Combined Amount
concepts.description: Represents the aggregate of total long-term debt, including current maturities and short-term debt.

concepts.label: Deferred Costs, Current
concepts.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of deferred costs capitalized at the end of the reporting period that are expected to be charged against earnings within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Deferred Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of deferred federal income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Gross
concepts.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

concepts.label: Deferred Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Gross
concepts.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences.

concepts.label: Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Net
concepts.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Rent Credit, Noncurrent
concepts.description: For a classified balance sheet, the cumulative difference between the rental income or payments required by a lease agreement and the rental income or expense recognized on a straight-line basis, or other systematic and rational basis more representative of the time pattern in which use or benefit is granted or derived from the leased property, expected to be recognized in income or expense, by the lessor or lessee, respectively, more than one year after the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Deferred Revenue, Current
concepts.description: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

concepts.label: Deferred State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Capital Loss Carryforwards
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible capital loss carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Deferred Income
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from deferred income.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Gross
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Investment in Subsidiaries
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from the entity's investment in its wholly-owned subsidiaries.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net
concepts.description: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, without jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net, Current
concepts.description: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, netted by jurisdiction and classified as current.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance
concepts.description: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance, Current
concepts.description: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards classified as current.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other
concepts.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences, classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other Comprehensive Loss
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from unrealized losses in other comprehensive income.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Property, Plant and Equipment
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards
concepts.description: Amount, before allocation of a valuation allowances, of deferred tax assets attributable to deductible tax credit carryforwards including, but not limited to, research, foreign, general business, alternative minimum tax, and other deductible tax credit carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, Alternative Minimum Tax
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible alternative minimum tax credit carryforwards.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Employee Compensation
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from employee compensation.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from reserves and accruals.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Allowance for Doubtful Accounts
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from the allowance for doubtful accounts.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Asset Retirement Obligations
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from asset retirement obligations. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement from service of a tangible long-lived asset.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Deferred Rent
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from deferred rent.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Impairment Losses
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from estimated impairment losses.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Reserves
concepts.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from reserves, classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Unrealized Losses on Available-for-Sale Securities, Gross
concepts.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from unrealized losses on available-for-sale securities.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance
concepts.description: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Net
concepts.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences without jurisdictional netting.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Inventory
concepts.description: Amount of deferred tax consequences attributable to taxable temporary differences derived from inventory.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Intangible Assets
concepts.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from intangible assets other than goodwill.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Net, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences, with jurisdictional netting and classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other
concepts.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences classified as other.

concepts.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Property, Plant and Equipment
concepts.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Discount Rate
concepts.description: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Expected Long-term Rate of Return on Plan Assets
concepts.description: Weighted average rate of return on plan assets, reflecting average rate of earnings expected on existing plan assets and expected contributions, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Contributions by Employer
concepts.description: Amount of contribution received by defined benefit plan from employer which increases plan assets.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, after Year Five for Next Five Years
concepts.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in five fiscal years after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year One
concepts.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Employer Contributions, Next Fiscal Year
concepts.description: Amount of contribution expected to be received by defined benefit plan from employer in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Employer Contributions, Remainder of Fiscal Year
concepts.description: Amount of contribution expected to be received by defined benefit plan from employer in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes contribution previously paid by employer in current fiscal year.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Return (Loss) on Plan Assets
concepts.description: Amount of expected return (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit, calculated based on expected long-term rate of return and market-related value of plan assets of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of asset segregated and restricted to provide benefit under defined benefit plan. Asset includes, but is not limited to, stock, bond, other investment, earning from investment, and contribution by employer and employee.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Funded (Unfunded) Status of Plan
concepts.description: Amount of funded (unfunded) status of defined benefit plan, measured as difference between fair value of plan assets and benefit obligation. Includes, but is not limited to, overfunded (underfunded) status.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Interest Cost
concepts.description: Amount of cost recognized for passage of time related to defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit)
concepts.description: Amount of net periodic benefit cost (credit) for defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Cost
concepts.description: Amount of cost for defined contribution plan.

concepts.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Discretionary Contribution Amount
concepts.description: Amount of discretionary contributions made by an employer to a defined contribution plan.

concepts.label: Deposits Assets, Current
concepts.description: Carrying value of amounts transferred to third parties for security purposes that are expected to be returned or applied towards payment within one year or during the operating cycle, if shorter.

concepts.label: Depreciation
concepts.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

concepts.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
concepts.description: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

concepts.label: Derivative Asset
concepts.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

concepts.label: Derivative Financial Instruments, Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Derivative instrument obligations meeting the definition of a liability which the Company is a party to as of the balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Derivative, Net
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

concepts.label: Derivative Liability, Current
concepts.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled within one year or normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

concepts.label: Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share, Dilutive Convertible Securities
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to net income used for calculating diluted earnings per share (EPS), resulting from the assumed exercise of dilutive convertible securities excluding adjustments related to ESOP convertible preferred stock, stock options, and restrictive stock units.

concepts.label: Dividends, Preferred Stock
concepts.description: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

concepts.label: Due from Affiliate, Current
concepts.description: Amount of receivables due from an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership, due within 1 year (or 1 business cycle).

concepts.label: Due to Affiliate, Current
concepts.description: Amount of payable due to an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Due to Affiliate
concepts.description: Amount of payable due to an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

concepts.label: Due to Affiliate, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount of receivables owed to an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership, which are usually due after one year (or one business cycle, if longer).

concepts.label: Due to Related Parties
concepts.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of obligations due all related parties.

concepts.label: Early Repayment of Senior Debt
concepts.description: The cash outflow for the extinguishment of long-term borrowing, with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, before its maturity.

concepts.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
concepts.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
concepts.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Enacted Tax Rate, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in the income tax rates.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to statutory income tax expense (benefit) outside of the country of domicile.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible expenses.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Impairment Losses, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to impairment loss.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Other, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other nondeductible expenses.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to state and local income tax expense (benefit), net of federal tax expense (benefit).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Percent
concepts.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to tax credits. Including, but not limited to, research credit, foreign tax credit, investment tax credit, and other tax credits.

concepts.label: Embedded Derivative, Fair Value of Embedded Derivative Liability
concepts.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives classified as a liability.

concepts.label: Embedded Derivative, Gain on Embedded Derivative
concepts.description: Increase in the fair value of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives included in earnings in the period.

concepts.label: Employee-related Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of cost not yet recognized for nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense, Tax Benefit
concepts.description: Amount of tax benefit for recognition of expense of award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation, Financing Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow from realized tax benefit related to deductible compensation cost reported on the entity's tax return for equity instruments in excess of the compensation cost for those instruments recognized for financial reporting purposes.

concepts.label: Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation, Operating Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow for realized tax benefit related to deductible compensation cost reported on the entity's tax return for equity instruments in excess of the compensation cost for those instruments recognized for financial reporting purposes.

concepts.label: Excise and Sales Taxes
concepts.description: The amount of excise and sales taxes included in sales and revenues, which are then deducted as a cost of sales. Includes excise taxes, which are applied to specific types of transactions or items (such as gasoline or alcohol); and sales, use and value added taxes, which are applied to a broad class of revenue-producing transactions involving a wide range of goods and services.

concepts.label: Extinguishment of Debt, Amount
concepts.description: Gross amount of debt extinguished.

concepts.label: Fair Value, Liabilities, Level 2 to Level 1 Transfers, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of transfers of liabilities measured on a recurring basis out of Level 2 of the fair value hierarchy into Level 1.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Interest Expense
concepts.description: Amount of interest expense on finance lease liability.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Interest Payment on Liability
concepts.description: Amount of interest paid on finance lease liability.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability
concepts.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Current
concepts.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as current.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payment, Due
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Next Rolling Twelve Months
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due after fifth fiscal year following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling after Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due after fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Four
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in fourth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Three
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in third rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Two
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in second rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Principal Payments
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow for principal payment on finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Amortization
concepts.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Amortization
concepts.description: Amount of amortization expense attributable to right-of-use asset from finance lease.

concepts.label: Finance Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
concepts.description: Weighted average discount rate for finance lease calculated at point in time.

concepts.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
concepts.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes allowance for financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

concepts.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
concepts.description: Amount of writeoff of financing receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.

concepts.label: Financing Receivable, Sale
concepts.description: Amount of decrease from sale and reclassification to held-for-sale of financing receivable.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Accumulated Amortization
concepts.description: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, after Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of amortization for asset, excluding financial asset and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Next Rolling Twelve Months
concepts.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year One
concepts.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling after Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Four
concepts.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Three
concepts.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Two
concepts.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Four
concepts.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Three
concepts.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Two
concepts.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Gross
concepts.description: Amount before amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Net
concepts.description: Amount after amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment, Excluding Oil and Gas Property and Timber Property
concepts.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, excluding oil and gas property and timber property.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Intangible Assets
concepts.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of intangible assets.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Investments
concepts.description: The net realized gain (loss) on investments sold during the period, not including gains (losses) on securities separately or otherwise categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity, which, for cash flow reporting, is a component of proceeds from investing activities.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) Related to Litigation Settlement
concepts.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in settlement of litigation and insurance claims. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt
concepts.description: Difference between the fair value of payments made and the carrying amount of debt which is extinguished prior to maturity.

concepts.label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt, before Write off of Debt Issuance Cost
concepts.description: Reflects the difference between the fair value of payments made to legally extinguish a debt and its carrying value at that time. This item excludes the write-off of amounts previously capitalized as debt issuance costs.

concepts.label: General and Administrative Expense
concepts.description: The aggregate total of expenses of managing and administering the affairs of an entity, including affiliates of the reporting entity, which are not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

concepts.label: Goodwill
concepts.description: Amount after accumulated impairment loss of an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Acquired During Period
concepts.description: Amount of increase in asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from a business combination.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Gross
concepts.description: Amount before accumulated impairment loss of an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.
