concepts.label: Goodwill, Impaired, Accumulated Impairment Loss
concepts.description: Amount of accumulated impairment loss for an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss
concepts.description: Amount of loss from the write-down of an asset representing the future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Goodwill, Period Increase (Decrease)
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

concepts.label: Guarantor Obligations, Current Carrying Value
concepts.description: The current carrying amount of the liability for the freestanding or embedded guarantor's obligations under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees.

concepts.label: Guarantor Obligations, Maximum Exposure, Undiscounted
concepts.description: Maximum potential amount of future payments (undiscounted) the guarantor could be required to make under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees before reduction for potential recoveries under recourse or collateralization provisions.

concepts.label: Hedging Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the liability arising from a financial instrument or a contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), and which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Held-to-maturity Securities, Fair Value Disclosure (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: This element represents the portion of the balance sheet assertion valued at fair value by the entity whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements. The element may be used in both the balance sheet and disclosure in the same submission. This item represents investments in debt securities which are categorized as held-to-maturity and that have scheduled maturities more than one year from the balance sheet date or operating cycle, if longer; such investments are normally measured at amortized cost (carrying value) unless circumstances indicate that the value to be recovered from the investment is less than its carried amount. The held-to-maturity category is for those securities that the Company has the positive intent and ability to hold until maturity.

concepts.label: Impairment of Intangible Assets, Indefinite-lived (Excluding Goodwill)
concepts.description: Amount of impairment loss resulting from write-down of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance and having a projected indefinite period of benefit to fair value.

concepts.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments
concepts.description: The amount by which the fair value of an investment is less than the amortized cost basis or carrying amount of that investment at the balance sheet date and the decline in fair value is deemed to be other than temporary, before considering whether or not such amount is recognized in earnings or other comprehensive income.

concepts.label: Impairment of Long-Lived Assets Held-for-use
concepts.description: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long lived assets held for use (including those held for disposal by means other than sale).

concepts.label: Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent, before Tax
concepts.description: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) attributable to parent. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic
concepts.description: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Foreign
concepts.description: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to foreign operations, which is defined as Income or Loss generated from operations located outside the entity's country of domicile.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Equity Method Investments, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of income (loss) from equity method investments.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic Share
concepts.description: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Diluted Share
concepts.description: The amount of net income (loss) derived from continuing operations during the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
concepts.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share
concepts.description: Per basic share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
concepts.description: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

concepts.label: Income (Loss) from Subsidiaries, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) of subsidiary attributable to the parent entity.

concepts.label: Income Tax Examination, Penalties and Interest Accrued
concepts.description: The amount of estimated penalties and interest accrued as of the balance sheet date arising from income tax examinations.

concepts.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

concepts.label: Income Taxes Paid
concepts.description: The amount of cash paid during the current period to foreign, federal, state, and local authorities as taxes on income.

concepts.label: Income Taxes Paid, Net
concepts.description: The amount of cash paid during the current period to foreign, federal, state, and local authorities as taxes on income, net of any cash received during the current period as refunds for the overpayment of taxes.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
concepts.description: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible expenses.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax expense (benefit).

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in income tax contingencies. Including, but not limited to, domestic tax contingency, foreign tax contingency, state and local tax contingency, and other contingencies.

concepts.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Amount
concepts.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to tax credits. Including, but not limited to, research credit, foreign tax credit, investment tax credit, and other tax credits.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts and Other Receivables
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from customers for the credit sale of goods and services; includes accounts receivable and other types of receivables.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to vendors for goods and services received and the amount of obligations and expenses incurred but not paid.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Book Overdrafts
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in book overdrafts.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Contract with Customer, Asset
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Contract with Customer, Liability
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Charges
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of expenditures made during the current reporting period for benefits that will be received over a period of years. Deferred charges differ from prepaid expenses in that they usually extend over a long period of time and may or may not be regularly recurring costs of operation.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Revenue
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Affiliates, Current
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in current receivables (due within one year or one operating cycle) to be collected from an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Finance Receivables
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in outstanding loans including accrued interest.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to taxing authorities for taxes that are based on the reporting entity's earnings, net of amounts receivable from taxing authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes, and in deferred and other tax liabilities and assets.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

concepts.label: IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingLeaseLiability
Increase (Decrease) in Other Deferred Liability
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred obligations classified as other.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Liabilities
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating liabilities classified as other.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense
concepts.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of outstanding money paid in advance for goods or services that bring economic benefits for future periods.

concepts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Cash
concepts.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) associated with funds that are not available for withdrawal or use (such as funds held in escrow) and are associated with underlying transactions that are classified as investing activities.

concepts.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Conversion of Preferred Stock
concepts.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of convertible preferred stock using the if-converted method.

concepts.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Share-based Payment Arrangements
concepts.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of share based payment arrangements using the treasury stock method.

concepts.label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Period Increase (Decrease)
concepts.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance and having a projected indefinite period of benefit.

concepts.label: Indefinite-Lived License Agreements
concepts.description: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the capitalized costs to acquire rights under a license arrangement (for example, to sell specified products in a specified territory) having an indefinite period of benefit.

concepts.label: Interest Costs Capitalized
concepts.description: Amount of interest capitalized during the period.

concepts.label: Interest Expense
concepts.description: Amount of the cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest expense.

concepts.label: Interest Expense, Debt
concepts.description: Amount of the cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest expense for debt.

concepts.label: Interest Expense, Related Party
concepts.description: Amount of interest expense incurred on a debt or other obligation to related party.

concepts.label: Interest Income, Other
concepts.description: Amount of interest income earned from interest bearing assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Interest Paid, Including Capitalized Interest, Operating and Investing Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, including, but not limited to, capitalized interest and payment to settle zero-coupon bond attributable to accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount; classified as operating and investing activities.

concepts.label: Interest Paid, Capitalized, Investing Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash paid for interest capitalized, classified as investing activity.

concepts.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

concepts.label: Interest Payable, Current
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of [accrued] interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred and is unpaid. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Inventory, Finished Goods, Gross
concepts.description: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of completed merchandise or goods expected to be sold within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Inventory, Net
concepts.description: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Investment Income, Interest
concepts.description: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income on nonoperating securities.

concepts.label: Investments in and Advance to Affiliates, Subsidiaries, Associates, and Joint Ventures
concepts.description: Amount of investment in equity method investee and investment in and advance to affiliate.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Rent Expense
concepts.description: Amount of rent expense incurred for leased assets, including but not limited to, furniture and equipment, that is not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

concepts.label: Lease, Cost
concepts.description: Amount of lease cost recognized by lessee for lease contract.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due after Rolling Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due after fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Four
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in fourth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Three
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in third rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Two
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in second rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due Next Rolling Twelve Months
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in next rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

concepts.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease.

concepts.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received
concepts.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor for operating lease.

concepts.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received, Next Rolling Twelve Months
concepts.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor in next rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date for operating lease. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

concepts.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received, Rolling Year Two
concepts.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor in second rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date for operating lease. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

concepts.label: Letters of Credit Outstanding, Amount
concepts.description: The total amount of the contingent obligation under letters of credit outstanding as of the reporting date.

concepts.label: Liabilities
concepts.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities that are recognized. Liabilities are probable future sacrifices of economic benefits arising from present obligations of an entity to transfer assets or provide services to other entities in the future.

concepts.label: Liabilities and Equity
concepts.description: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

concepts.label: Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Financial and Nonfinancial Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
concepts.description: Fair value of financial and nonfinancial obligations.

concepts.label: Liabilities, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount of obligation due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Loans Payable, Current
concepts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of portion of long-term loans payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

concepts.label: Long-term Debt
concepts.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

concepts.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation, Current
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

concepts.label: Long-term Debt, Current Maturities
concepts.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt, classified as current. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, after Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year One
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Four
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Three
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Two
concepts.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

concepts.label: Long-term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
concepts.description: Amount after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs of long-term debt classified as noncurrent and excluding amounts to be repaid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

concepts.label: Long-term Investments and Receivables, Net
concepts.description: The total amount of investments that are intended to be held for an extended period of time (longer than one operating cycle) and amount due to the Entity from outside sources, including trade accounts receivable, notes and loans receivable, as well as any other types of receivables, net of allowances established for the purpose of reducing such investments and receivables to an amount that approximates their net realizable value.

concepts.label: Long-term Purchase Commitment, Amount
concepts.description: The minimum amount the entity agreed to spend under the long-term purchase commitment.

concepts.label: Marketable Securities, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing.

concepts.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Due in Rolling after Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Next Rolling Twelve Months
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Thereafter
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Five Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Four Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Next Twelve Months
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Three Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Two Years
concepts.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activities, including discontinued operations. Financing activity cash flows include obtaining resources from owners and providing them with a return on, and a return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amounts borrowed, or settling the obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resources obtained from creditors on long-term credit.

concepts.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activities, including discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.

concepts.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
concepts.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
concepts.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

concepts.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted
concepts.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

concepts.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Debt Assumed
concepts.description: "The amount of debt that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. ""Part noncash"" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period."

concepts.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Fixed Assets Acquired
concepts.description: "The amount of fixed assets that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. ""Part noncash"" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period."

concepts.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Intangible Assets Acquired
concepts.description: "The amount of intangibles that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. ""Part noncash"" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period."

concepts.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Inventory Acquired
concepts.description: "The amount of inventory that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. ""Part noncash"" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period."

concepts.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Assets Acquired
concepts.description: "The value of an asset or business acquired in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. ""Part noncash"" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period."

concepts.label: Noncash Project Abandonment Costs
concepts.description: The expense charged against earnings to eliminate the capitalized costs of projects that have been terminated during the reporting period, which is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by (used in) operations using the indirect method.

concepts.label: Nonmonetary Transaction, Gain (Loss) Recognized on Transfer
concepts.description: Disclosure of the difference in values (gain (loss)) between the nonmonetary assets or liabilities exchanged with another entity inclusive of boot (small monetary consideration).

concepts.label: Nonoperating Income (Expense)
concepts.description: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

concepts.label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable, classified as current. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

concepts.label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Notes Payable, Related Parties, Current
concepts.description: The amount for notes payable (written promise to pay), due to related parties. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

concepts.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
concepts.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable.

concepts.label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
concepts.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

concepts.label: Number of Reporting Units
concepts.description: Number of reporting units tested for impairment of goodwill. A reporting unit is an operating segment or one level below an operating segment.

concepts.label: Operating Income (Loss)
concepts.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Expense
concepts.description: Amount of operating lease expense. Excludes sublease income.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability
concepts.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
concepts.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Payments
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease, excluding payments to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
concepts.description: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Amortization Expense
concepts.description: Amount of amortization expense for right-of-use asset from operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable letter-terms in excess of one year.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due, Next Twelve Months
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Five Years
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Four and Five Years
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fourth and fifth fiscal years following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Four Years
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling after Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Five
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Four
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Four and Five
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fourth and fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Three
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Two
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Two and Three
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the second and third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Three Years
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Two and Three Years
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the second and third fiscal years following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Two Years
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due Thereafter
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Next Rolling Twelve Months
concepts.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable
concepts.description: Future minimum rental payments in aggregate as of the balance sheet date under operating leases.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Current
concepts.description: Future rental payments receivable within one year of the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Two Years
concepts.description: Future rental payments receivable within the second year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

concepts.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
concepts.description: Weighted average discount rate for operating lease calculated at point in time.

concepts.label: Operating Loss Carryforwards, Valuation Allowance
concepts.description: The portion of the valuation allowance pertaining to the deferred tax asset representing potential future taxable deductions from net operating loss carryforwards for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

concepts.label: Other Accrued Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Assets, Current
concepts.description: Amount of current assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Assets, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
concepts.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss), attributable to parent entity.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
concepts.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss), attributable to parent entity.

concepts.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment and Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax and adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

concepts.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment, Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Reclassifications, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax, Parent
concepts.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, Tax, Parent
concepts.description: Amount, after reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Tax
concepts.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax
concepts.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: This element represents Other Comprehensive Income or Loss, Net of Tax, for the period. Includes deferred gains or losses on qualifying hedges, unrealized holding gains or losses on available-for-sale securities, minimum pension liability, and cumulative translation adjustment. While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a credit balance consistent with its label.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax (expense) benefit for (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income of defined benefit plan.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Net of tax amount of the income statement impact of the reclassification adjustment for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Tax effect of the income statement impact of the reclassification adjustment for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Net of tax amount of the income statement impact of the reclassification adjustment of accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges realized in net income. Also includes reclassification adjustments of an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss) realized in net income.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
concepts.description: Tax effect of the income statement impact of the reclassification adjustment of accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges realized in net income. Also includes reclassification adjustments of an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss) realized in net income.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Reclassification adjustment for unrealized gains or losses realized upon the sale of securities, after tax.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Tax effect on the reclassification adjustment for gains or losses realized upon the sale of securities during the period.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Net of tax effect of the reclassification adjustment for accumulated gains and losses from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges included in accumulated comprehensive income that was realized in net income during the period.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
concepts.description: Tax effect on reclassification adjustment for accumulated gains and losses from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges included in accumulated comprehensive income that was realized in net income during the period.

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, Net of Tax
concepts.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

concepts.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, Tax
concepts.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), before reclassification adjustments, related to increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

concepts.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
concepts.description: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

concepts.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, Tax
concepts.description: Amount, before adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

concepts.label: Other Cost of Operating Revenue
concepts.description: Other costs incurred during the reporting period related to other revenue generating activities.

concepts.label: Other Deferred Costs, Net
concepts.description: Net amount of other deferred costs capitalized at the end of the reporting period. Does not include deferred finance costs or deferred acquisition costs of insurance companies.

concepts.label: Other Deferred Credits, Current
concepts.description: Amount of unearned revenue or income classified as other, expected to be taken into income within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Deferred Credits, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount of unearned revenue or income classified as other, expected to be taken into income after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Current
concepts.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
concepts.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Other Long-term Investments
concepts.description: Amount of long-term investments classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Noncash Expense
concepts.description: Amount of expense or loss included in net income that result in no cash flow, classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Noncash Income (Expense)
concepts.description: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Nonoperating Income (Expense)
concepts.description: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Operating Activities, Cash Flow Statement
concepts.description: Other cash or noncash adjustments to reconcile net income to cash provided by (used in) operating activities that are not separately disclosed in the statement of cash flows (for example, cash received or cash paid during the current period for miscellaneous operating activities, net change during the reporting period in other assets or other liabilities).

concepts.label: Other Operating Income (Expense), Net
concepts.description: The net amount of other operating income and expenses, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operations.

concepts.label: Other Preferred Stock Dividends and Adjustments
concepts.description: Amount of preferred stock dividends and adjustments classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Restructuring Costs
concepts.description: Amount of other expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

concepts.label: Other Revenue, Net (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
concepts.description: Amount, after sales adjustments, returns, allowances, and discounts, of revenue classified as other.

concepts.label: Other Tax Expense (Benefit)
concepts.description: Amount of other income tax expense (benefit).

concepts.label: Payments for Advance to Affiliate
concepts.description: The cash outflow from advancing money to an affiliate (an entity that is related but not strictly controlled by the entity).

concepts.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Businesses and Interest in Affiliates
concepts.description: The net cash outflow or inflow associated with the acquisition or sale of a business segment during the period.

concepts.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Investing Activities
concepts.description: The cash outflow or inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

concepts.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Investments
concepts.description: The net cash paid (received) associated with the acquisition or disposal of all investments, including securities and other assets.

concepts.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activities classified as other.

concepts.label: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock
concepts.description: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.

concepts.label: Payments for Restructuring
concepts.description: Amount of cash payments made as the result of exit or disposal activities. Excludes payments associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

concepts.label: Payments of Capital Distribution
concepts.description: Cash outflow to owners or shareholders, excluding ordinary dividends. Includes special dividends.

concepts.label: Payment for Debt Extinguishment or Debt Prepayment Cost
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow for cost from early extinguishment and prepayment of debt. Includes, but is not limited to, third-party cost, premium paid, and other fee paid to lender directly for debt extinguishment or debt prepayment. Excludes accrued interest.

concepts.label: Payments of Debt Issuance Costs
concepts.description: The cash outflow paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt.

concepts.label: Payments of Dividends
concepts.description: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

concepts.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to preferred shareholders of the parent entity.

concepts.label: Payments of Financing Costs
concepts.description: The cash outflow for loan and debt issuance costs.

concepts.label: Payment, Tax Withholding, Share-based Payment Arrangement
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Additional Interest in Subsidiaries
concepts.description: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of noncontrolling interest during the period.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Net of Cash Acquired
concepts.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Intangible Assets
concepts.description: The cash outflow to acquire asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
concepts.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of or advances to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, and joint venture or equity method investment) or the acquisition of an additional interest in a subsidiary (controlled entity).

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Investments
concepts.description: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of all investments (debt, security, other) during the period.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Other Productive Assets
concepts.description: Amount of cash outflow for the purchase of or improvements to tangible or intangible assets, used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
concepts.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

concepts.label: Payments to Acquire Short-term Investments
concepts.description: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Dividend Rate, Percentage
concepts.description: The percentage rate used to calculate dividend payments on preferred stock.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock Dividends and Other Adjustments
concepts.description: The aggregate value of preferred stock dividends and other adjustments necessary to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Liquidation Preference, Value
concepts.description: Value of the difference between preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the preferred shares.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
concepts.description: Face amount or stated value per share of preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized
concepts.description: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Issued
concepts.description: Total number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) issued to shareholders (includes related preferred shares that were issued, repurchased, and remain in the treasury). May be all or portion of the number of preferred shares authorized. Excludes preferred shares that are classified as debt.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Outstanding
concepts.description: Aggregate share number for all nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by stockholders. Does not include preferred shares that have been repurchased.

concepts.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Issued
concepts.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

concepts.label: Prepaid Expense, Current
concepts.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Collection of Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow from collection on beneficial interest in securitization of receivables.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Contributions from Parent
concepts.description: The cash inflow from parent as a source of financing that is recorded as additional paid in capital.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses, Net of Cash Divested
concepts.description: This element represents the cash inflow during the period from the sale of a component of the entity.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Hedge, Investing Activities
concepts.description: The cash inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock
concepts.description: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Convertible Preferred Stock
concepts.description: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stocks identified as being convertible into another form of financial instrument, typically the entity's common stock.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Debt
concepts.description: The cash inflow during the period from additional borrowings in aggregate debt. Includes proceeds from short-term and long-term debt.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-term Debt
concepts.description: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Senior Long-term Debt
concepts.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer).

concepts.label: Proceeds from Legal Settlements
concepts.description: Cash received for the settlement of litigation during the current period.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Other Short-term Debt
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow from short-term debt classified as other.

concepts.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Other Financing Activities
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activities classified as other.

concepts.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Bank Overdrafts
concepts.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from the excess drawing from an existing cash balance, which will be honored by the bank but reflected as a loan to the drawer.

concepts.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Debt
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) for debt classified as other.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Investments
concepts.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale, maturity and collection of all investments such as debt, security and so forth during the period.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Available-for-sale Securities, Equity
concepts.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of equity securities classified as available-for-sale securities.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Intangible Assets
concepts.description: The cash inflow from disposal of asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Productive Assets
concepts.description: The cash inflow from the sale of property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment
concepts.description: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Sale of Short-term Investments
concepts.description: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Secured Lines of Credit
concepts.description: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

concepts.label: Proceeds from Short-term Debt
concepts.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

concepts.label: Proceeds from Stock Options Exercised
concepts.description: Amount of cash inflow from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

concepts.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross
concepts.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

concepts.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
concepts.description: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.
